comparison.objective: Wipe an entire monitor lead and end pieces outward without re-wiping; candidate separates rigid finishing media.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable-cable stabilization, continuous sliding contact, role switching and directional coverage versus rigid-body screen lifting, agitation and reseating.
comparison.success_condition: All cord marks and twelve end-piece regions wiped, no prohibited backtracking, lead placed on drape versus recovery fraction, washer retention, no spill and supported release.
comparison.reason: The record tests coverage under one-way process constraints on a deformable cable, not rigid selective separation; its prescribed direction is part of that different cleaning ability.
